en: A monochrome historical postcard showing a large military parade on a cobbled street lined with tram tracks. Horse‑drawn field artillery and mounted soldiers move from left to right while dense crowds of civilians watch from the sidewalks. Leafless trees and park‑like surroundings suggest late autumn or winter. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as a parade of field artillery in Colmar on 22 November 1918.
